prompt: Many children today are overweight. This is a serious health problem. Give the reasons for this and give the solutions to solve this problem.
essay:
Around the world, many health issues are increasing.  Obesity is one of these main health issues. Kids suffer most from this problem.  This essay will examine the  reasons for child obesity and provide solutions to solve this problem.

On the one hand, there are several  reasons  responsible for child obesity. Firstly, kids are less active as technology keeps improving every day. For example, they prefer playing virtual games instead of engaging in physical activities. Additionally, an unhealthy environment can discourage children. Secondly, consuming unhealthy food is a huge problem. For instance, today, there are many delivery applications that make it easy for kids to access fast food. For example, in children's birthday parties, the family serves an excessive amount of sweets. Thirdly, some children suffer from genetic problems. Unfortunately, obesity can occur  because of the parents' unawareness of past family genetic problems.  In addition, parents are not practising annual doctor check-ups.

On the other hand, each problem has a solution. First of all, children should be more active.  They should adopt sports  such as basketball and football. Also, they can set a physically active schedule, including walking and  cycling. Second, eating more healthy food is a priority. Cooking homemade healthy meals can help prevent obesity. Parents can teach their kids about the cons of junk food. Third, parents should be aware of their elders' medical history. For example, they should check their family medical records via the clinic. Communication between relatives can be useful too. Also going to the doctor for regular check-ups is a positive step.

In conclusion, it is clear to see that multiple things cause child obesity.  However, with the introduction of a healthy lifestyle, this can solve many child health problems.
